visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an adult male dressed in a full Santa Claus costume, including a red hat and white beard, walking down a modern residential hallway. He carries a lavender-colored rectangular gift box decorated with a drawing of a Christmas tree. The hallway features dark-colored minimalist cabinets on one side and a red and blue punching bag hanging nearby. The lighting is warm and comes from recessed ceiling lights. (2) Santa carefully kneels on the light-colored wooden floor to place the purple gift box next to a black pet bed. The camera is held at a medium height, capturing his controlled movements and gloved hands. A few white shoes are scattered near the cabinets in the background. (3) The scene cuts to a bedroom where a young girl in purple pajamas and a boy in a yellow shirt are playing on a large bed with grey and white bedding. The girl holds a yellow and blue baby bottle while jumping and rolling around. The room is softly lit with warm indoor lighting. (4) A woman in white and black patterned pajamas leads the little girl out of the bedroom towards the living area. The girl stops and looks towards the floor where the purple box is located. A large white Labrador dog wearing a harness enters the frame, wagging its tail. Two boys are already sitting on the wooden floor near a white leather sofa. (5) The girl and the two boys gather around the purple box on the floor. The girl touches her face with a shy, expectant expression. In the background, a decorated Christmas tree with blue and yellow string lights and a large Mickey Mouse figure are visible. The setting is a spacious, modern apartment living room. (6) The children begin unwrapping the purple gift box, revealing a cardboard toy package inside. The boys assist the little girl with removing the outer paper and then help her open the plastic inner packaging. The girl's facial expressions shift from curiosity to excitement as the contents are revealed. (7) The girl successfully pulls out a Super Mario action figure from the box, which is identified as a Super Mario themed toy set. She holds the red-capped figure and a green-capped Luigi figure in her hands, examining them closely. The boys continue to interact with the remaining pieces in the box while the large white dog watches from the background.
